name: Can a pool remodel fix a leaking pool in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Can a pool remodel fix a leaking pool in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: Can a pool remodel fix a leaking pool in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a remodel can fix a leaking pool, but only if the leak source is diagnosed and repaired as part of the project. Common causes include cracks in the shell, damaged plumbing lines, failed light niches, skimmer leaks, and waterline waterproofing failures around tile and coping. If the contractor only applies a new finish without repairing the cause, the leak may continue. That is why leak detection should happen before finish work begins. Once the source is understood, the contractor can decide whether the repair is minor or whether it requires more extensive demolition and reconstruction. Sometimes the leak repair is straightforward; sometimes it reveals that other aging components should be replaced at the same time. Homeowners should ask whether the estimate includes testing, leak repair, and post-repair verification. A remodel is the right time to address leak issues because the pool is already drained and accessible. Fixing the leak during the remodel is usually more efficient than waiting until after new finishes are installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pool remodel can fix a leaking pool if the cause is identified and included in the scope. Common leak repairs include shell cracks, plumbing repairs, skimmer or light fixture sealing, and coping or tile waterproofing issues. A remodel alone will not solve a leak unless the leak source is found first.
